rules.query: assignee = currentUser() AND issuetype = Epic AND status IN ("In Progress", "In Review")
assignee = currentUser() AND issuetype = Story AND status IN ("In Progress", "In Review")
assignee = currentUser() AND issuetype = Task AND status IN ("In Progress", "In Review")
assignee = currentUser() AND issuetype = Bug AND status IN ("In Progress", "In Review")
assignee = currentUser() AND issuetype = "Sub-task" AND status IN ("In Progress", "In Review")
rules.brief: You own one subtask. Read it with jira_get_issue — its description and its parent's ticket say what done means. Do exactly that work, then report_to_boss (no key — it always posts to YOUR OWN ticket) and submit_to_boss (no arguments) to move it to In Review. If an outward action (a `gh` command, `git push`, a jira_*/butchr call) gets a permission prompt or "denied", don't assume policy: check your own claude argv and report it on your ticket rather than retrying blindly.
